type Expr = Num(Int) | Add(Expr, Expr) | Mul(Expr, Expr) | Neg(Expr)

fn eval(e: Expr) -> Int
  decreases e
  = match e {
    Num(n) => n
    Mul(a, b) => eval(a) * eval(b)
    Neg(a) => 0 - eval(a)
  }

fn size(e: Expr) -> Int
  ensures result >= 1
  decreases e
  = match e {
    Num(_) => 1
    Add(a, b) => 1 + size(a) + size(b)
    Mul(a, b) => 1 + size(a) + size(b)
    Neg(a) => 1 + size(a)
  }

fn main() -> (Int, Int) = {
  let e = Add(Mul(Num(3), Num(4)), Neg(Num(5)))
  (eval(e), size(e))
}
```
